agendas.name: Angels of Death
agendas.description: At battle end, if no enemy units remain on the battlefield, each ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit still on the battlefield gains 2XP. The force also gains 2 Honour points.

agendas.name: Know No Fear
agendas.description: Post-game: each ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that never failed a Battle-shock test gains 1XP (2XP if the unit was Below Half-strength at any point). Track Battle-shock pass/fail per unit during the game.

agendas.name: Armoured Assault
agendas.description: Post-game: each surviving ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE gains 1XP. Each destroyed VEHICLE that destroyed 2+ enemy units during the battle also gains 1XP.

agendas.name: Quest of Atonement
agendas.description: Pre-game: select 1 ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit with a Battle-weary, Disgraced, or Mark of Shame scar. If that unit destroyed an enemy Character, Monster, or Vehicle in melee, it loses 1 scar and gains 5XP.

agendas.name: Show Them How We Fight
agendas.description: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a WOLF GUARD unit, select one friendly BLOOD CLAWS unit within 6"; that unit gains 1XP. For each BLOOD CLAWS unit that gained 2+ XP from this agenda, the force gains 2 Honour points.

agendas.name: Savage Fury
agendas.description: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a melee attack made by a SPACE WOLVES unit, that unit gains 1XP. Max 3XP per unit from this agenda.

agendas.name: Howls of Vengeance
agendas.description: Each time an enemy unit that has destroyed one or more of your units is itself destroyed by a SPACE WOLVES unit, that unit gains 2XP. At battle end, if 3+ such vengeance destroys were made, the force gains 4 Honour points.
